JSON to Python Dataclass

Convert JSON to Python @dataclass models — nested classes, List/Dict/Optional typing included.

📖 How to use

  1. Paste your JSON sample.
  2. Set the root class name.
  3. Click Generate to build the dataclasses.
  4. Copy the code or download models.py.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How are nested objects handled?

Each nested object becomes its own @dataclass, referenced by the parent field.

How are lists typed?

As List[ItemType] with field(default_factory=list) so mutable defaults are safe.

What about null values?

They become Optional[UnknownType] = None — the real type cannot be known from null alone.

Which Python version works?

The output uses dataclasses and typing, so Python 3.7+.
